name: HFS
description:
HFS is an HTTP file server with uploads, downloads, user accounts, permissions,
a virtual file system and plugins. Manage it through the Admin panel and share
files with users through the web interface.
This installation starts with a dedicated empty shared folder. To share an
existing folder, change the host path of the /shares volume in app settings.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Hfs initial admin password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  hfs:
    image: rejetto/hfs:v3.3.4
    restart: unless-stopped
    network_mode: bridge
    ports:
      - target: 80
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    environment:
      HFS_PORT: "80"
      HFS_INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_HFS_INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /data
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/shares
        target: /shares
